methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops delivered by a local native signal grassroots capability-building outside traditional tech hubs, demonstrating distributed peer-to-peer knowledge transfer that could democratize AI fluency in military-adjacent regions.

signals.title: TAYLOR: AI data centers increase Virginia’s urban-rural divide - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: Commentary explicitly naming AI data centers as drivers of urban-rural divide reveals concentration dynamics in NoVA, where capital-intensive infrastructure reinforces rather than redistributes capability and economic benefit.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA to boost community AI education signals intentional knowledge distribution infrastructure in Richmond, creating pathways for deeper capability-building beyond elite tech concentrations.

signals.title: Children’s National and Virginia Tech deepen pediatric AI collaboration to accelerate innovation for children - Children's National Hospital
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech's deepening pediatric AI collaboration with Children's National concentrates advanced research capability in established academic centers, reinforcing hub specialization rather than distributing technical capacity to underserved regions.

signals.title: More than 30,000 customers await broadband connections as provider struggles to complete work
signals.signal_reading: 30,000+ customers awaiting basic broadband connections in Southside reveals infrastructure failure that prevents both shallow and deep AI adoption, leaving rural regions unable to access even platform-delivered tools as metro areas advance.
